questions.question: Why is a standard LLM described as a 'genius locked in a box'?
options: It can think but cannot directly act in the real world

questions.question: What extra capability turns an LLM into an AI Agent?
options: A specific goal, logic loop, and access to tools

options: To connect the model to real-world tools and services
To eliminate the need for prompts
